params.prompt:
Image 1 is the picture to edit: five characters in an office, seen from high on one end wall. Image 2 is the SAME office from the SAME camera with nobody in it, after it has been wrecked.

Redraw Image 1 so that the room around the five characters looks exactly like the wrecked room in Image 2, while the five characters stay exactly as they are in Image 1.

KEEP from Image 1, unchanged: the camera and framing; every one of the five characters — the small terracotta cube creature sitting writing on a sheet of paper at the far wall, the small lavender cloud creature at the foot of the server rack, the young man with short blonde hair in the navy T-shirt sitting at the desk in the office chair turned towards the room with his hands on the keyboard, the small blue-purple star creature on the floor by the worktable, and the round grey creature with the big pointed ears and the wide friendly grin on the open floor near the desk — each in the same spot, the same pose, the same size, the same face, the same colours and the same line.

TAKE from Image 2, and draw it around them: the left wall taped over floor to ceiling with small sketches and the drifts of sketches across the floor half-burying the worktable; the wide flat screen popped out of the server rack on its arm, full of dense dashes and blocks like code, with cabling spilling from the rack; the three enormous flag-fringed towers of paper at the far wall's right end rising out of the top of the frame, with sheets carpeting the floor around them; the spill of plaster rubble, broken laths and dust with the nose of the cardboard rocket poking in at the right edge; the curling streamers and confetti over the desk and the floor; and loose sheets of paper scattered flat across the whole floor. Where a character stands on the floor, the paper and rubble lie around its feet, never over it.

Warm cream drawing paper throughout, a pale putty cream, never white and never yellow. The floor is the same cream a half-step darker. Walls and floor are flat, quiet, and low-contrast — the room is a pale ground, and colour lives only on small props. Graphite line and cross-hatch shadow carry all the form. Overall value stays high-key and even: no dark corners, no pooled shadow, no colour cast, no vignette, no dramatic lighting.

Hand-drawn animation pencil test: graphite line, visible construction lines, cross-hatch shadow, light coloured-pencil wash on props only, paper tooth showing — no flat vector fill, no digital gradients, no painterly rendering, no photographic lighting, no 3D. Do not add any text.
